text:
[LTAC.4.2] Timer facts are one-shot. The follow-up rule's action
list ends with the engine's retraction of the timer fact
([LTAC.3.4]). A timer fact must not survive its firing.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__state
idris.note: The quiescent state: the timer live only while not yet due. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__wm
idris.note: The timer gone once the clock has reached `fire_at`: one-shot, as the quiescent state has it.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__after_ticks_is_state
idris.note: After any tick history the state is quiescent at its clock: the timer gone if due.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__gone_is_an_instance
idris.note: ONE-SHOT at the one-shot history, through the theorem: the clock reaches `fire_at`, so the timer is not in working memory after. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__gone_once_due
idris.note: A timer fact must not survive its firing: once the history reaches `fire_at`, it is not in working memory.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__idle_net
idris.note: The state with no timer activation pending. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_executed
idris.note: One firing over four ticks past `fire_at`. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_is_an_instance
idris.note: THE THEOREM AT THE ONE-SHOT HISTORY: the counts over ticks 1 to 4 are the clause's, `[0, 1, 0, 0]` -- the due tick with ticks after it. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__retract_timer
idris.note: THE FOLLOW-UP'S RHS: the retraction of the timer it matched, its last and only action.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_fires
idris.note: One firing, the timer gone, nothing left to fire.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_idle
idris.note: No timer activation, no firing.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__step_fires
idris.note: The firing's last action retracts the timer, which does not survive it: gone from working memory, the alpha and the terminal.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__timer_gone_executed
idris.note: The timer does not survive its firing. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__both_gone
idris.note: Neither timer survives its firing. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_4_3__independent_counts
idris.note: Each of two timers fires once. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__at_most_once_is_an_instance
idris.note: At most one firing over any tick history: the timer is one-shot.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_net
idris.note: The state the one firing consumes. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__edges_after_due
idris.note: After the firing, no later tick makes an edge: nothing re-fires.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__ticked_run
idris.note: The run fires at most once per tick for one timer, and takes the timer when it does.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_pump
idris.note: A pump fires the timer at most once and leaves it gone when it does.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost
idris.note: Exactly one firing once due, never two.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost_is_an_instance
idris.note: NEVER LOST at the one-shot history: the counts sum to one, the final clock having reached `fire_at`. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_trace
idris.note: Each of two timers due on one tick is retracted by its own firing. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_3_1__body_runs_timed
idris.note: The timer gone after the body ran. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__follow_up
idris.note: The retraction of the timer as the RHS's last action, with no author syntax: `Withdraw 0` on the follow-up's one bound fact. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__state_timed
idris.note: The quiescent state: the timer live only while not yet due. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_3_4__wm_timed
idris.note: The timer gone once the clock has reached `fire_at`: one-shot, as the quiescent state has it. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__after_cycles_is_state_timed
idris.note: THE STATE AFTER A TICK HISTORY IS THE QUIESCENT STATE AT ITS CLOCK, the wall and the stamps standing: the cycles land on `state_timed` at the clock the ticks reach.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__alphas_two
idris.note: Two alphas: the trigger's kind 0 and the timer's kind 1. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__fire_idle_timed
idris.note: NOTHING FIRES FROM AN IDLE STATE, whatever working memory holds: no activation, no selection. Computed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__gone_once_due_timed
idris.note: ONE-SHOT, on the Idris model's engine: once a history's clock has reached the stamp plus the duration, the timer is not in working memory -- the follow-up's retraction took it, and the state holds nothing for a later tick to re-fire.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__idle_timed
idris.note: AN IDLE STATE: the follow-up with nothing to fire over a working memory at a clock. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__life
idris.note: THE LIFECYCLES of the one-timer fixtures: the trigger an entity, every other kind -- the timer, a body's `ttl` fact -- explicit. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__one_shot_timed
idris.note: ONE-SHOT, EXECUTED THROUGH THE LOWERING: the trigger asserted and pumped at 0 fires the parent, which mints the timer; the advance to 6 and a pump fire the follow-up once; the advance to 8 and a pump fire nothing -- logical/LTAC.4.2's shape. And the timer is gone: working memory holds the trigger alone. Executed.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__rules
idris.note: THE ONE-SHOT PROGRAM, lowered: `auto_off` on the trigger with `after 5: <nothing>` -- the parent emitting the timer, and the follow-up on it (logical/LTAC.4.2's shape, the log aside). A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_fires_timed
idris.note: THE RUN FROM THE DUE STATE: the one firing, then nothing to fire; quiescent, the timer gone, one firing traced.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__run_idle_timed
idris.note: THE RUN FROM AN IDLE STATE fires nothing: quiescent at once, nothing traced.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__step_fires_timed
idris.note: THE FOLLOW-UP FIRES AND RETRACTS ITS TIMER on the Idris model's engine: one firing from the due state -- no cooldown, so the gate admits -- marks the activation, runs the withdraw through the stamped RHS, which stamps nothing, and leaves the timer gone from working memory, the alpha and the terminal, the wall, the stamps and the trackers as they were. Computed, once the timer's own equality and the gate's reading are given.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__tests
idris.note: The one-shot program's tests: the parent untimed, the follow-up's guard. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__verdicts_of
idris.note: The verdicts of a schedule on a lowered one-timer program, from the loaded network. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_4_2__wm_after
idris.note: The working memory after a schedule on a lowered one-timer program. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__at_most_once_timed
idris.note: AT MOST ONCE: over any tick history from any starting clock the follow-up fires at most once -- the `dwell` gate is rising (the clock never goes back, the stamp stays) and C3a bounds a rising gate's edges by one.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__born_run_timed
idris.note: The run fires at most once per cycle for one timer, and takes the timer when it does.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__due_timed
idris.note: The state the one firing consumes. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__firings_if
idris.note: One firing or none. A fixture.

idris.name: ltac_5_1__timer_cycle
idris.note: A pump fires the timer at most once and leaves it gone when it does.

idris.name: ltac_5_3__never_lost_timed
idris.note: Exactly one firing once due, never two.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_timed
idris.note: Each of two timers due on one tick is retracted by its own firing. Executed.
